Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification ("white-out") of the left hemithorax with a distinct mediastinal and tracheal shift to the right (away from the opacity). This indicates a space-occupying lesion, most likely a massive pleural effusion pushing the structures contralaterally, whereas atelectasis would pull the trachea toward the affected side.
